title: Most news apps try to guess what you like by tracking every single click.
body:
That approach feels invasive and often leads to an echo chamber where you only see more of the same. At Headlinne, we decided to build our feed differently. Instead of relying solely on tracking your behavior, our AI focuses on semantic understanding of the news itself.

We prioritize identifying the core topics and entities in a story. When you tell us what you care about, we match your interests to the actual substance of the reporting rather than just predicting what you might click on next. This keeps the feed broader and more relevant to your actual curiosity.

It is a subtle shift in engineering, but it makes a massive difference in the quality of your daily digest. We want to give you a full picture of the world, not just a mirror of your past habits.
cta: You can see how this approach changes your reading experience at HEADLINNE.com
